none: PAS NLM-2A7B93: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Barton upon Humber
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, Gloria Exercitus issue, probably of 335-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust, probably right. Obverse inscription: [--]CONS[---]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with, probably, one standard between them; the standard has a large umbrella-shaped top. Reverse inscription: GLORI AEXERCITVS. In exergue: TRP.
